sampling: Body blocks (prose paragraphs, list items, tables, display equations; headings and images excluded) numbered 1-26 from L16; took blocks 2,5,8,11,14,17,20,23,26, then wrapped to 3 and 18 (table). Claims drawn from L20, L30, L36, L42, L50, L60, L71, L79, L83, L24, L64, L67.

A: Topic-name headings L18, L28, L46, L52, L73; otherwise correct front matter (subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math) and math markup.
B: L50 '학습 처리량이 전체 파인튜닝보다 25% 높습니다' sits next to 32.5 vs 43.1 tokens/s, so the sentence is internally inconsistent (see F) -> '학습이 약 25% 빨라집니다(처리량 32.5 -> 43.1토큰/초)'.
L71 formulaic '예를 들어 가상의 설정으로, ... 모델을 생각해 볼 수 있습니다' -> '가령 WikiSQL용으로 ... r=4 행렬을 붙여 학습한 모델도 합친 뒤에는 ...'.
L38 double '그래서'; L26 '결국 ...'; term mixing 'Adapter-L' (L71) vs '$$\text{Adapter}^{\text{L}}$$' (L24), '편향' (L42) vs '바이어스' (L80).
L54 '데이터가 적을 때도 잘 버티며' is vague -> '학습 예제가 100개뿐일 때도 파인튜닝보다 높으며'.
C: L60 '앞서 소개한 MNLI 무작위 부분집합' refers to something never introduced.

L71 '앞서 본 배치 크기 1, 짧은 시퀀스의 온라인 설정' - L24 said only '배치가 작은 온라인·짧은 시퀀스 환경'; batch 1 / seq 128 first appears here. The paragraph also re-defines Adapter-L and switches from GPT-2 latency to a GPT-3 hypothetical.
L75 repeats L44's task-swap example almost verbatim.
D: Good: L38 explains why alpha is not tuned; L40 numeric parameter count; L42 relates LoRA's limit to full fine-tuning.
L48 rank evidence is a list of numbers without saying what 'intrinsic rank' means for the reader beyond the label.
E: Main GPT-3 175B comparison (Table 4) and rank sweep (Table 6) have no table; L48 and L71 carry 7 numbers in prose.
L62-67 table is verbatim, one header row, equal cell counts.
F: L50 '학습 처리량이 전체 파인튜닝보다 25% 높습니다' - the paper reports a '25% speedup'; its own throughput numbers (32.5 -> 43.1 tokens/s per V100, quoted in the next sentence) are +32.6% throughput, i.e. ~25% less time. The quantity changed definition.
L83 '낮은 내재 랭크를 확인한 실험이 GPT-3에서 영어 과제 두 개를 다룬 데 그치므로' - the paper repeats the rank experiment on GPT-2 (Sec H.2, E2E NLG), so the premise of the writer's assessment is inaccurate.
L30 intrinsic-dimension definition is not in the paper (unsourced external gloss).
U1: Results stop at the prefix-scaling, low-data and latency analyses; the paper's main benchmarks (GPT-3 Table 4, RoBERTa/DeBERTa GLUE, GPT-2 E2E) and the 10,000x / 3x reductions are missing.
U2: Plain-prose TL;DR with no math; limitations grounded (L79-81). Repetition of merging/no-latency (L16, L44, L71, L75) and the swap example (L44, L75).
